claim: phenotype-AR2 loop-gain inversion has an exact finite coefficient-error bound and becomes ill-conditioned as community memory approaches one

local_jacobian.conditioning_result: loop-gain inverse sensitivity diverges like 1/(1-phi) as phi approaches one

independent_random_bound_audit.domain: 0<=phi<0.98, -0.5<=L<=1.5; E1 sampled below 0.4*(1-phi); independent E2 envelope

structural_gap_propagation.interpretation: integer structural-gap diagnostics require uncertainty narrow enough to distinguish neighboring integer gaps

singular_boundary.failure_interpretation: lag-one coefficient uncertainty crosses the phi=1 singular boundary, so a finite model-specific L bound is not available from this envelope

scope: deterministic coefficient-error sensitivity only; no statistical consistency claim for noisy, finite, irregularly sampled ecological time series
